description: This file defines a generic event bus with publish-subscribe capabilities, allowing real-time event distribution in a concurrent environment.

classes.name: EventBus[T any]
classes.description: A generic struct implementing a pub/sub pattern with thread-safe subscriber management.

methods.name: NewEventBus[T any]
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new instance of EventBus with default buffer size.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers a new subscriber with a unique ID and returns a channel to receive events.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unregisters a subscriber by ID and closes its channel.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Distributes an event to all active subscribers, dropping events if the subscriber channel is slow.

methods.name: SubscriberCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of registered subscribers.
